BETFAIR HUB | RACING RESULTS

If you’re looking for accurate, up-to-date racing results, you’ve come to the right place. Whether you’re following horse racing, trots, or the dogs, having access to verified results is essential for reviewing your performance, refining your strategy, or simply keeping up with the latest action. At Betfair, we provide fast, reliable, and detailed results across all three codes—thoroughbred, harness, and greyhound—so you can stay informed and ahead of the game. In addition to the racing results you can see the Betfair Starting Price (BSP) compared to the average fixed odds across Sportsbet, Ladbrokes and Tab 60 seconds out from the jump. Once you see the BSP consistently beating the fixed odds prices, you’ll understand why it’s the most valuable product in the market.

For punters, racing results are more than just numbers on a screen. They tell the story of a race—how the pace unfolded, who defied the odds, and where your selections finished. By examining race outcomes, you can learn a lot about form, fitness, and tactics, and apply those insights to future betting decisions. That’s why our results aren’t just quick—they’re also comprehensive, making them ideal for punters who want to go beyond the basics.

Our platform includes full harness racing results, covering meetings from across Australia and New Zealand. These results break down each runner’s performance, sectional timing, and margin—giving you everything you need to assess how a race unfolded. Whether you’re a casual punter or a more analytical harness racing fan, these results help build your understanding of form lines and driver tactics. When you’re trying to find that next edge, it pays to know what happened yesterday—so you’re ready for what’s running today.

Likewise, we offer complete and up-to-date greyhound results, capturing every race from the country’s major greyhound tracks. Greyhound racing is fast-paced and form-driven, and punters rely heavily on recent performance to guide their bets. Whether you’re following early speed, late sectionals, or box bias, our greyhound results are updated promptly so you can check where your runner finished and how the race played out. They’re also archived, so if you missed a meeting or want to do some in-depth research, all the information is at your fingertips.

Of course, horse racing remains at the heart of Australian punting culture, and our detailed racing results provide everything you need to analyse meetings from around the country. Whether you’re chasing a Group 1 result from Randwick or tracking a provincial maiden at Ballarat, you’ll find clear, accurate results posted shortly after the race is run. These updates make it easy to track your bets, follow favourite horses, and spot emerging form patterns.

With so many racing codes running every day, having all your racing results in one convenient place is a major advantage. Whether you want to review how a race played out today, or cross-check several meetings to build your weekend multi, Betfair’s results hub makes the process quick and easy. You don’t need to jump between multiple sources—we bring you harness racing results, greyhound results, and thoroughbred results in one clean interface.

Our results page is a useful resource for both recreational punters and those who treat betting more seriously. It offers a fast way to check your outcomes, as well as a platform for more detailed race analysis. From stewards’ reports to sectional splits, everything you need to stay informed is just a click away.

So whether you’re chasing a big win or just reviewing the day’s action, Betfair’s racing results hub has you covered. Check back regularly for the latest harness racing results, greyhound results, and horse racing outcomes from around the country—all in one place, every day.
